market_summary: Global markets rallied this week with the S&P 500 reaching 7,764.70 (+1.49%) and Nasdaq hitting a record 27,122.09 (+2.26%) as AI-related stocks surged on optimism over chip demand and AI applications. Singapore's blue-chip banks reported strong 1H2026 results driven by wealth management, with DBS posting record S$6.01 billion net profit and OCBC's non-interest income jumping 36%. Technology stocks led broad gains, with semiconductor stocks rallying on stronger demand dynamics. Investors continue to balance excitement about AI product launches against concerns over elevated capital spending by mega-cap tech companies.

items.headline: Singapore Banks Report Strong 1H2026 Results Driven by Wealth Management
items.summary: DBS posted record net profit of S$6.01 billion (+5% YoY) with wealth AUM exceeding S$500 billion. OCBC's non-interest income surged 36% to S$3.51 billion, while UOB reported broadly in-line earnings with lower fee income growth.

items.headline: Keppel Reports Strong H1 2026 Performance with New Business Growth
items.summary: Keppel's net profit from 'new businesses' increased 25% YoY to S$530 million in H1 2026, with funds under management reaching S$106 billion, exceeding its S$100 billion year-end target.

items.headline: Singtel Weighs Potential IPO for India Data Centre Business
items.summary: Singtel is considering a potential initial public offering for its India Data Centre Business as part of strategic portfolio optimization.

items.headline: Semiconductor Stocks Surge on AI Demand; Intel Up 12%, AMD at Trillion Dollar Valuation
items.summary: Intel popped 12% and Advanced Micro Devices added 10%, reaching US$1 trillion in market cap, as chipmakers benefit from strong AI infrastructure spending demand.

items.headline: Meta Launches Muse AI Agent; Stock Rallies But Faces Pullback on Spending Concerns
items.summary: Meta announced its Muse AI agent across glasses and pocket devices, sparking a sharp rally, but the stock pulled back 3.33% as investors weigh product excitement against heavy AI capital spending and slower earnings upgrades.

items.headline: Tesla Semi Truck Production Starts in Nevada; FSD Approval Delayed in Europe
items.summary: Tesla began Semi truck production scaling at its Nevada factory, but faced mixed sentiment as European Full Self-Driving approval was delayed and analysts cut price targets.

items.headline: S&P 500 and Nasdaq Hit Record Highs; AI Stocks Lead Rally
items.summary: S&P 500 climbed to 7,764.70 (+1.49%) while Nasdaq hit record 27,122.09 (+2.26%) as artificial intelligence-related stocks surged amid strong chip demand outlook.

items.headline: Berkshire Hathaway Boosts Alphabet Stake by $17 Billion; Google Parent Becomes Third-Largest Holding
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway added US$17 billion to its Alphabet stake in Q2 2026, making Google parent the third largest holding in Warren Buffett's portfolio.

items.headline: Microsoft Jumps 4% After Revamping Copilot with Code Generation and Agentic AI Tools
items.summary: Microsoft stock rose 4% following announcement of Copilot enhancements including code generation and agentic AI capabilities, supporting momentum in enterprise AI adoption.

items.headline: Singapore Airlines Adjusts Network for 2026 Northern Summer Season
items.summary: Singapore Airlines announced flight frequency adjustments and capacity boosts on select routes for the 2026 Northern Summer operating season to support travel demand.

items.headline: Thai Beverage Expands Cambodia Operations with Five New Subsidiaries
items.summary: Thai Beverage established five new indirect subsidiaries in Cambodia focused on investment holdings and non-alcoholic beverages, logistics and asset management, marking strategic growth in Southeast Asia.

items.headline: CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust Pursues Portfolio Reconstitution Strategy
items.summary: CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust continues accretive portfolio recycling and reconstitution efforts to optimize asset mix and returns for unitholders.
